changelog:
Initial release of finalplace-auto-organize.

- Provides a skill to drive FinalPlace’s Windows app auto-rules engine for automated file organization (sort, move, copy, compress, unzip, rename by extension, name, size, time, or content).
- Triggers only when FinalPlace (or 归所) is explicitly mentioned or installed and the user wants to use its rules engine.
- Enforces user confirmation before any file-modifying actions; only read-only operations run without confirmation.
- Relies on installed FinalPlace and active membership; includes installation guidance if missing.
- All actions and error handling conform strictly to documented CLI behaviors, safety rails, and output envelopes.
summary: Drive the installed FinalPlace Windows desktop app's auto-rules engine to automatically organize files — auto-sort, move, copy, compress, unzip, or rename fi...
